vector: logos EDB snapshot hash reads its rows as a SET v1 (#2279)
note: Hand-authored from seat:caa's ruling on #2279 (2026-09-24): `edb_table_hash` / `EdbTableHash` / `edbTableHash` hashes the canonical SET of rows, sorted by the ground key and deduplicated by the same key the sealed `RelationTable` uses, so order and multiplicity never change the hash. No digest is authored here (a digest needs the implementation under test); every case is an EQUIVALENCE over hashes, derived from the set rule alone. `rows` names ground literals of `pred` by their atom arguments. Each `equal` group lists row-name lists whose hashes must all be equal to each other. Each `differ` pair must hash differently, which keeps the equal groups from passing on a constant hash. `table_agrees` lists row lists whose hash must equal the hash over the rows of the sealed table built from them, so a snapshot and a certificate's table built from the same rows agree by construction. Replayed by contract/rs/tests/edb_snapshot_set_vectors.rs, contract/go/edb_snapshot_set_vectors_test.go and contract/ts/test/edb_snapshot_set_vectors.test.ts.
